title_en: Law of the People's Republic of China on the Immunity from Compulsory Judicial Measures of the Property of Foreign Central Banks

articles.content_en: Article 1 The People's Republic of China shall grant immunity from compulsory measures of judicial property preservation and enforcement in respect of the property of foreign central banks; provided that this shall not apply where the foreign central bank or the government of its country has waived such immunity in writing or the property has been designated for property preservation and enforcement.

Article 2 For the purposes of this Law, "foreign central bank" means a central bank of a foreign country or of a regional economic integration organization, or a financial regulatory authority that performs the functions of a central bank.
For the purposes of this Law, "property of a foreign central bank" means cash, negotiable instruments, bank deposits, securities, foreign exchange reserves, gold reserves, and immovable property and other property of such bank.

Article 3 Where a foreign country does not grant immunity to the property of the People's Bank of China or the financial regulatory authority of a special administrative region of the People's Republic of China, or grants immunity lower than that provided for in this Law, the People's Republic of China shall act on the basis of the principle of reciprocity.
Article 4 This Law shall come into force as of the date of promulgation.
